name: AP Business
tagline: One kit per unit. Pick a unit to study; progress in each one is saved in this browser.

units.label: Unit 1
units.title: Business, Competition, and New Ideas
units.blurb: What a business is, markets and competitive advantage, PESTEL, where ideas come from, vision, ethics, business structures and supply chains (topics 1.1 to 1.8).

units.label: Unit 2
units.title: Marketing
units.blurb: Marketing to customers, consumer behavior, market research, and the 4 Ps: product, price, place and promotion (topics 2.1 to 2.7).
